action.objective: Trade knights on c6, keeping material level and eliminating the active c6-knight after ...Bxc3+ bxc3 bxc6.
action.rationale: Nxc6 is the only commit_ready move: verified at depth 4 with exact score 6, complete immediate-mate scope and no tactical refutation. PV ...Bxc3+ bxc3 bxc6 leaves White with two bishops for a rook, giving lasting activity. Odd double-pawns on c2/c3 and an exchange deficit are acceptable for open lines against the Black king. Alternatives only have shallower upper-bound estimates and are not comparable evidence.
